messages:
sofia: Heads-up — next week's Architecture Feedback Hours: thinking of splitting into two short sessions (EMEA/APAC friendly). Idea: 30m morning slot for quick triage + 30m late-day for deeper design reviews. Thoughts? :wave:
luke: +1 to split. Can we bundle small RFCs (<=2 reviewers) into a 'lightning triage' block so folks don't need full slots?
maya: Love the lightning block. Suggest lightning = 10m slots, max 3 items.
sofia: yea — plan:
```
- 30m slot A (08:30-09:00 PT) — lightning triage (3x10m)
- 30m slot B (16:30-17:00 PT) — deep reviews (up to 2x15m)
```
we'll rotate hosts weekly. Need owners for next 3 weeks.
anna: I can host week of Apr 7 (will prep one-pager template)
raj: I'm in for Apr 14. Can someone draft the lightning template? short: context + ask + risk
diane: can we have a 'parking lot' doc for items needing follow-up? less overhead in the meeting.
sofia: yes — will create a shared doc. also proposing a 'prep by Friday' cutoff for submitting lightning items.
infra-bot: Reminder: create-calendar-event command available. Use `/cal create "Arch Feedback Hours" 2025-04-07T08:30 PT` to seed invites.
luke: can we add an optional 'async feedback' thread in the RFC repo for anyone who can't make it?
sofia: good call — will add PR template link in the invites. Also rotating host checklist:
- claim slot in #eng-platform
- add items + assign reviewers
- post one-pager by Fri
anna: posted host checklist in the doc. ping me if you want the one-pager template.
maya: ok let's run it for two cycles and collect notes. fyi I might swap Apr 14 host with raj if calendar clash.
sofia: thanks all — i'll create events and the doc now. tagging @here in #eng-platform when it's live. :calendar:
